facts.fact: Africa Data Centres operates the NBO1 Nairobi data centre at Sameer Industrial Park, offering colocation (private cage, secured racks, cross connects); the page gives no date, so the 2026 published year is used.

Africa Data Centres states its NBO1 Nairobi facility has four data halls certified Uptime Institute Tier III, with 7.5 MW available site capacity; no certification date is given, so the 2026 published year is used.
